def forward(self, L_u_ : torch.Tensor, L_v_ : torch.Tensor, L_x_ : torch.Tensor):
    l_u_ = L_u_
    l_v_ = L_v_
    l_x_ = L_x_
    getitem = l_u_[0];  l_u_ = None
    getitem_1 = l_v_[0];  l_v_ = None
    layer_norm = torch.nn.functional.layer_norm(l_x_, (768,), getitem, getitem_1, 1e-05);  l_x_ = getitem = getitem_1 = None
    return (layer_norm,)
